_comment: Narration lexicon (natural-sounding-narration-with-frankentts). Chapter 01 says no proper name and no term of art beyond everyday words (volt, battery, current, junction, wire), so nothing is respelled. 'Ohm' and 'Kirchhoff' appear only on screen, in the 01_2 lower-third. Before any chapter says 'Kirchhoff', 'Ohm', 'Doyle', 'Snell', 'Polya' or 'Wheatstone', look it up, audition it against a control and a decoy, and lock it here with its sources; the owner's pronunciation overrides every source.
